paragraph: A final rehearsal of the full demonstration repeated the end-to-end test with Zabbix and the push loop running. 5 of the 5 attacks were answered automatically with the expected action, 1.1 to 1.9 seconds after the window closed, and Zabbix received 117 anomaly scores and 7 response actions during the run; the security alerts opened 7 problems in Zabbix, one for each PC that was acted on, each staying open until an administrator closes it. 2 alert-only false alarms occurred and no user was blocked, quarantined or disabled by mistake. The lowest free memory during the run was 2457 MB.
